work.summary: Designing and implementing secure cloud and on-premises solutions to monitor distributed systems. Driving continuous improvements using open standards and best-practices. Escalating, root cause analyzing and resolving software defects and performance issues. Peer-reviewing code to maintain quality and sharing knowledge across teams. Supporting field engineers with software installations, patching, and upgrades. Investigating field issues, assistance requests (ARs), customer complaints, non-compliance (NC), and participating in post-mortem analysis.

work.summary: Designing, developing, testing, documentating, and packaging software. Creating an innovative pulse shaping framework (shapr) to overcome major challenges in the domain of ultrafast spectroscopy. Designing novel data acquisition techniques and data processing algorithms. Managing laboratory equipments and assets (lasers, spectrometers, spatial-light modulators). Maintaining and optimizating high-power femto-second lasers (oscillator, amplificator, strecher, compressor). Investigating light-matter interaction to understand and control the dynamics of energy conversion and transfer in macro-molecules.

projects.name: shapr
projects.description: A pure-Python library to push forward scientific progress in ultrafast spectroscopy using pulse shaping techniques via spatial light modulators (SLMs).

projects.name: andor
projects.description: A pure-Python library to control the hardware of Andor cameras, spectrographs, and spectrometers. Developed to be integrated with the shapr library.

projects.name: avantes
projects.description: A pure-Python library to control the hardware of Avantes USB-2 spectrometers. Developed to be integrated with the shapr library.

projects.name: git-conventional-changelog
projects.description: A pure-Python command line tool to generate changelogs (.md, .html) from the history of any git repository by following best practices (semantic versioning, keep a Changelog, conventional commit)
